title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: At fifteen, Elymas Edvaughn, heir to a line of master swordsmen, receives the scorned 'Heavy Knight' class at his blessing ritual and is disowned and exiled by his father. Remembering a past life in which this world was a game he played, he knows the class is the strongest of all and sets out as an adventurer to prove it (K Manga blurb via AniList; Seven Seas blurb via MangaUpdates).
life_message: Knowledge and patient work can turn what others call a weakness into strength, regardless of family rejection.
